selection_rule: Sort eligible development scenarios by width then nominal demand; take 25th and 75th percentile positions using floor((n-1)*p); no HK or new service outcomes used
interpretation: Hypothesis sensitivity only: scale both robot dimensions and thus actual JuPedSim radius by 0.8 or 1.2; separately change bidirectional split from .5 to .75. No claim of calibrated physical range. Every configuration has its own complete 30-seed baseline.
